about.title: Who we are
about.lead: Together We Made Power is a Ukrainian charity fund run by volunteers. We find out what people need, gather it with our partners and deliver it by hand.
about.photo: Volunteers of the fund unloading boxes of aid

how.title: How we work
how.lead: Every delivery follows the same four steps, from the first message to the moment help arrives.

request.title: We hear the need
request.text: A mother, a family with children or a shelter writes to us, or our volunteers on the ground tell us what is missing.

check.title: We check it
check.text: A coordinator talks to the people asking and confirms what exactly is needed, how much and by when.

collect.title: We gather the aid
collect.text: We buy what is needed with your donations or get it from partners, then sort and pack it.

deliver.title: We deliver it
deliver.text: Our volunteers take the aid to the people themselves and report back with photos on Instagram.

about.partnerNote: Want your company to join them?

legal.title: Legal details
legal.text: The fund is officially registered in Ukraine as a charitable organisation. You can check us in the state register by this code.
legal.name: Legal name

helpPage.title: Ask us for help
helpPage.lead: If you are raising a child who fled from another region, a child with a disability or other difficulties, or you are a single mother, write to us. We read every message and answer as soon as we can.
helpPage.handle: Our Instagram: @twmp.foundation. Direct messages are open to everyone.

who.title: Who can ask
who.lead: Our help is for children and for mothers raising them on their own.

displaced.title: Displaced children
displaced.text: Children who had to leave their homes in other regions because of the war, and their families.

disabilities.title: Children with disabilities
disabilities.text: Children with disabilities, special needs or other difficulties.

mothers.title: Single mothers
mothers.text: Mothers raising children on their own, including mothers of newborns.

animals.title: Pets, sometimes
animals.text: Now and then we help animal shelters and families' pets with food and care.

who.note: We focus on children, so we usually can't help adults without children. What we can give depends on our current projects and donations. If we can't help, we will try to point you to someone who can.

write.title: What to write
write.lead: A complete first message saves time for everyone. Please include:

city.title: Your city
city.text: Where you live now, and where you moved from if you are displaced.

family.title: Your children
family.text: How many children, their ages, and any disability or special needs.

need.title: What you need
need.text: Be specific: food, clothes and sizes, baby items, medicine, something else.

contact.title: How to reach you
contact.text: A phone number, or say that Instagram messages are fine.

write.template:
Hello! My name is …
I live in … (moved from …)
Children: … (ages …; disability or special needs: …)
What we need: …
How to reach me: …

read.title: We read your message
read.text: A coordinator reads it and replies in Instagram. It can take a few days when there are many requests.

clarify.title: We ask questions
clarify.text: We may ask for a few more details, for example to confirm your status or the sizes you need.

plan.title: We find the help
plan.text: We add you to the nearest delivery or project, or point you to a partner who can help faster.

deliver.title: You get it
deliver.text: We agree on a time and place together, or bring the aid to you.

privacy.title: Your details stay private
privacy.text: We use what you tell us only to help you. We never publish it or pass it to anyone without your consent.

volunteerPage.title: Help with your time
volunteerPage.lead: The fund runs on volunteers. Join us for one delivery or for every one: each pair of hands means more children helped.

ways.title: Ways to help
ways.lead: Choose what suits you. You do not need experience: we will show you how.

driving.title: Driving
driving.text: Take aid to families with children and to shelters in your own car.

packing.title: Packing
packing.text: Sort donations and pack food sets, baby boxes and gifts.

translating.title: Translating
translating.text: Help us talk to partners abroad and translate reports, posts and letters.

events.title: Events
events.text: Help run charity brunches, fairs and holidays for children.

design.title: Design and IT
design.text: Make posts and posters, take photos, or help with the website.

asks.title: What we ask
asks.lead: Volunteering is free and flexible, but people rely on us, so we ask for three things.

reliable.title: Reliability
reliable.text: If you say you will come, come. If plans change, tell the coordinator early.

time.title: A few hours a month
time.text: Even one shift a month helps. You choose the days that work for you.

care.title: Care and respect
care.text: We work with people in hard times, so we treat them and their details with care.

apply.title: How to apply
apply.lead: Send us a direct message on Instagram. Use the template: it covers everything we need to know.

write.title: Write to us
write.text: Copy the template, fill it in and send it to @twmp.foundation.

chat.title: Meet the coordinator
chat.text: We reply, get to know you and tell you about the nearest tasks.

start.title: Join a task
start.text: Come to your first delivery or packing day. A team member will be with you.

apply.template:
Hello! I'd like to volunteer.
My name is …
City: …
How I can help: driving / packing / translating / events / design and IT
Time I can give: … hours a month
How to reach me: …

companies.title: For companies
companies.text: Businesses help us with money, goods, services and their teams' time. We agree on a joint project and report on every step.
